name: Notifications
author: VanillaGreen
description: The desktop notification daemon: Spotlight glass toasts on every screen, an Inbox and History panel, and Silence. Toggle the panel with the vgs.notifications:inbox shortcut or IPC.

duration.label: Toast duration
duration.description: Seconds a normal toast stays on screen; a low-urgency one stays for at most 5

slackToken.label: Slack token
slackToken.hint: Needed for sender photos in Slack notifications
slackToken.command: secret-tool store --label='VGS notifications Slack token' service vgs-notifications account slack
